recently used items when the cache reaches its maximum capacity, and also
supports per-item TTL expiry where items are automatically removed after a
specified time-to-live period.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time

K = TypeVar("K", bound=Hashable)
V = TypeVar("V")


class LRUCache(Generic[K, V]):
    """
    A thread-safe LRU cache with optional TTL (Time-To-Live) expiry.

    This cache stores key-value pairs and automatically evicts the least
    recently used items when the cache exceeds its maximum size. Additionally,
    each item can have an optional TTL after which it is considered expired
    and will be removed on access or during cleanup.

    Attributes:
        maxsize: The maximum number of items the cache can hold.
        default_ttl: The default time-to-live in seconds for items without
                     an explicit TTL. If None, items do not expire by default.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        maxsize: int = 128,
        default_ttl: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialize the LRU cache.

        Args:
            maxsize: The maximum number of items the cache can hold.
                     Must be a positive integer.
            default_ttl: The default time-to-live in seconds for items.
                         If None, items do not expire by default.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If maxsize is not a positive integer.
        """
        if not isinstance(maxsize, int) or maxsize <= 0:
            raise ValueError("maxsize must be a positive integer")
        if default_ttl is not None and (not isinstance(default_ttl, (int, float)) or default_ttl <= 0):
            raise ValueError("default_ttl must be a positive number or None")
